senses.gloss: m. (בטל) interruption, loss of time; abrogation; relinquishment, renunciation.
units: <cite ref="Kiddushin 33a:2">Kidd. 33ᵃ</cite> <he>קימה שאין בה ב׳</he> rising (in honor of an elder &c.) which causes no interruption of labor.—<he>ב׳ תורה</he> neglect of the study of the Law.
<cite ref="Menachot 99a">Men. 99ᵃ</cite> sq. <he>פעמים שבִּיטוּלָהּ וכ׳</he> sometimes the neglect of the Law is its establishing.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 16:1">Sabb. XVI, 1</cite> <he>ב׳ בה״מ</he> neglect of lectures (through reading at home).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 4:3:6">Y. Peah IV, 18ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>ב׳ עניים</he> loss of time to the poor (when compelled to wait for their share in the crop).—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Gittin 4:5:3">Y. Gitt. IV, 46ᵃ</cite> top, a. fr. <he>ב׳ פריה ורביה</he> neglect of marital life.—Y. Ab. Zar. III, 43ᵈ bot. <he>יש לה ב׳</he> can be cancelled, v. ib. IV, 4 s. v. <cite ref="B00515"><he>בָּטֵל</he></cite> Pi.—
<cite ref="Pesachim 4b:5">Pes. 4ᵇ</cite> <he>בב׳ בעלמא וכ׳</he> a mere relinquishment of possession would be sufficient.; a. v. fr.
